method: Linear quantiles. Inclusive phase timings retain transition/action frames; stable samples and boundary frames are also reported separately. Counters are asynchronous observations, not additive attribution.
limitations: One baseline and two candidate runs; no A/B/A.

First candidate regressed and is retained. Final candidate prepares hidden print during inspection in field-sized slices, with a 2 ms between-field budget. Individual fields/final upload may exceed that budget.
Process, physics and render counters overlap/lag. No cross-cell streaming or cold asset-I/O isolation is claimed.
Captures excluded from measured phases. No runtime_contract or human acceptance.
